channel.serverchan.desc: Send messages through ServerChan SC3 or Turbo
channel.serverchan.field.token.desc: SendKey; a key starting with sctp selects SC3 and any other key selects Turbo
channel.serverchan.field.tags.desc: SC3 tags; an array or a comma-separated string is joined with a pipe
channel.serverchan.field.short.desc: Short card description, with template support
channel.serverchan.field.channels.desc: SC3 message channels; an array or a comma-separated string is joined with a pipe
channel.serverchan.field.openids.desc: SC3 openids receiving a copy; an array or a comma-separated string is joined with a pipe
channel.serverchan.error.invalid_sc3_key: the SC3 SendKey {{.TokenMasked}} does not match sctp<uid>t...
channel.serverchan.error.empty_title: title is required because ServerChan does not accept an empty title
channel.serverchan.error.bad_response: the ServerChan response could not be read: {{.Detail}}
channel.serverchan.warn.title_truncated: the Turbo title was cut at the {{.Limit}} character limit
